column2: Named by Michel Chevreul in the 1810s from the Greek for pearl, for the sheen of its crystals, and margarine was named after it. What Chevreul had found turned out to be a mixture of two other fatty acids.
DHA, the omega-3 in oily fish and a big part of the fat in your brain and retinas. Its initials are on so many fish oil and baby formula labels that it's far from obscure.
EPA, the other omega-3 in fish oil beside DHA. Its initials are on so many supplement labels that it's far from obscure.
